text: TSMC reports Q3 revenue of NT$1.49T and net income of NT$763.1B, both above estimates. Profit rises 68.7% annually, with operating margin at 58.7%. Advanced nodes account for 79% of wafer revenue and high-performance computing for 68% of total revenue.

meta.note: Capacity constraints are company-reported; projected capital spending and Arizona production dates are not realized outcomes.
